in_marathi.name: Rajsekhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajsekhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rajsekhar is a compound of two words - Raja meaning King and Ishvara meaning God. Thus, the name Rajsekhar can be interpreted as 'The rule of the King-God'. This name is a powerful name that denotes the power and authority of the king and the god. It is a name that is associated with royalty, power, and victory.
